## Variables

### FaqChat

```ts
const FaqChat: ForwardRefExoticComponent<
  Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, "title"> &
    object &
    RefAttributes<HTMLElement>
>;
```

A chat-shaped FAQ. Visitors pick or type a question and get the caller's
reviewed answer with its next steps. Message rows follow Parakeet: the visitor's
turn sits on the surface with a primary rule, the answer is plain.

## Functions

### matchFaqEntry()

```ts
function matchFaqEntry(entries, text): FaqChatEntry | undefined;
```

Routes a typed question to the entry whose keywords it mentions most. Returns
undefined when nothing matches, so the caller can answer honestly.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                                       |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `entries` | readonly [`FaqChatEntry`](#faqchatentry)[] |
| `text`    | `string`                                   |
